name: SPOT HEARTS
description: Spot Hearts is a trick-taking variant where each heart scores its pip value (2 through 10 face value, jack 11, queen 12, king 13, ace 14; queen of spades 25). Players avoid winning tricks containing penalty cards; the game is played to a higher target (e.g. 500) and the lowest score wins.

content.text: Spot Hearts is a trick-taking variant where each heart scores its pip value (2 through 10 face value, jack 11, queen 12, king 13, ace 14; queen of spades 25). Players avoid winning tricks containing penalty cards; the game is played to a higher target (e.g. 500) and the lowest score wins.

Spot Hearts is a scoring variant of Hearts. Hearts first appeared at the end of the nineteenth century and is now popular in various forms in many countries; Spot Hearts keeps the standard American Hearts deal and play but assigns penalty points by each heart's pip value and a higher game target.
Four players. Spot Hearts is most commonly played by four; there are no formal partnerships.

A standard 52-card deck is used, with no jokers. All 52 cards are dealt out one at a time so each player receives 13 cards. Spot Hearts uses the same deck as standard Hearts; only the penalty scoring differs (hearts count their pip value, queen of spades 25).

Deal and play are clockwise. All 52 cards are dealt out one at a time so that each player has 13. After the deal, each player passes three cards face-down (first hand to the left, second to the right, third across, fourth hand no pass; the cycle repeats).
